ja: • 張飛ガンダムの新装備バージョン。 ■真雷蛇が付属。。 ■肩鎧のジョイント部分の変更により鎧の交換時にパーツをバラさず付け替え可能。■別売り「龍装　劉備ガンダム」「鬼牙装　関羽ガンダム」のパーツを使い三位一体を再現。 ■背中の刀が矛と合体し、大型武器へパワーアップ。 成形品×4、シール×1、取説マンガ有り
en: • New equipment version of Zhang Fei Gundam. ■Shinraija is included. . ■By changing the joint part of the shoulder armor, you can replace the parts without taking them apart when replacing the armor. ■Reproduce the Trinity using the parts of "Dragon Armor Liu Bei Gundam" and "Oni Fang Armor Kanu Gundam" which are sold separately. ■The sword on the back combines with the spear and powers up into a large weapon. Molded product x 4, Seal x 1, instruction manual manga included
